_comment: Each entry names a registered datrix.languages / datrix.platforms target
(entry-point name, unfolded -- a platform name backed by a shared package
such as 'local' with 'docker', or 'azure-vm' with 'azure', still gets its
own entry, since the gate checks every registered name independently)
whose own source does not yet realize a pooled cache member's declared
slice_index in its emitted output. pinned_count is the reviewed count of
len(exemptions); a realization change removes its own entry and
decrements this field in the SAME change -- the field never silently
drifts from the live count (the gate fails loud if it does).
